_comment: Copy to tdr_credentials.json and fill in. That filename is gitignored.
The CloudFront cookies are time-limited and must be refreshed periodically;
tilearc fails with a clear 'credentials expired' message rather than a wall
proxy_url  routes through your Cloudflare Worker (the default, and what the
viewer does). Only 'proxy_url' is needed for this mode.
origin_base + user_agent + cookies are needed only for --direct.
